info.name: Oracle Subscription API
subscription
Lists subscriptions that are consumed by the compartment. Only root compartment is allowed.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The ID of the subscription to which the tenancy is associated.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, whether 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order can be provided.
* The default order for timeCreated is descending.
* The default order for displayName is ascending.
* If no value is specified, timeCreated is the default.

params.name: entityVersion
params.description: The version of the subscription entity.

items.docs: Lists subscriptions that are consumed by the compartment. Only the root compartment is allowed.

info.name: Cancels a Subscription.

params.name: subscriptionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the subscription.

items.docs:
Requests cancellation of a Subscription. The subscription transitions to PendingCancellation
and remains active until the end of the current billing cycle, at which point it transitions
to Canceled. The subscription must be in the Active state to be canceled.

info.name: Moves a Subscription into a different compartment.

params.description: The unique identifier for the subscription.

items.docs:
Moves a Subscription into a different compartment within the same tenancy. For information about moving resources between
compartments, see [Moving Resources to a Different Compartment](/iaas/Content/Identity/Tasks/managingcompartments.htm#moveRes).

info.name: List work requests

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: workRequestId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the asynchronous work request.

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only the resources that match the given lifecycle state.

params.name: resourceId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the resource affected by the work request.

params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous
"List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`).

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for `timeAccepted` is descending.

items.docs: Lists the work requests in a compartment.
